# European Commission - Trade and Economic Security

> The European Commission's official trade portal providing comprehensive guidance on EU trade policy, market access, import/export regulations, and bilateral trade agreements with global partners.

This site serves as the EU's authoritative source for trade policy, negotiation frameworks, and market access information. It covers EU trade strategy, international agreements, regulatory requirements for importers and exporters, and detailed country-specific trade relations aligned with principles of open strategic autonomy.

## Key Topics

- Trade Policy
- Market Access
- Trade Agreements
- EU Trade Strategy
- Import/Export Rules
- Economic Security
- Trade Negotiations
- Trade Barriers
- International Trade
- CETA
- WTO
- Country Trade Relations
- Dual-Use Controls
- Public Procurement
- Intellectual Property

## Trade Policy & Strategy

- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/index_en.htm): Main trade policy hub covering agreements, negotiations and strategy
- [EU position in world trade - Trade and Economic Security](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/eu-position-in-world-trade/index_en.htm): EU's global trade position, statistics and market analysis
- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/eu-position-in-world-trade): EU's strategic position in global trade and economic security

## Import & Export Rules

- [Import and export rules - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/import-and-export-rules/index_en.htm): Central hub for EU import and export rules and trade information
- [Import and export rules - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/import-and-export-rules/import-into-eu): Detailed guide to importing goods and services into the EU
- [EU companies accessing world markets](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/import-and-export-rules/export-from-eu/dual-use-controls): Guide to dual-use export controls and trade rules for EU exporters

## Market Access & Trade Barriers

- [Accessing EU markets](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/accessing-markets/index_en.htm): Main portal for market access strategies and trade barriers
- [Accessing EU markets](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/accessing-markets/goods-and-services): Rules and requirements for importing goods and services into the EU
- [Accessing EU markets](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/accessing-markets/public-procurement): Public procurement rules and market access requirements for EU
- [Accessing EU markets](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/accessing-markets/intellectual-property): Intellectual property protections and market access requirements

## Trade Agreements & Partnerships

- [Countries and Regions - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/countries-and-regions/index_en.htm): Directory of trade relations, agreements and partnerships by country
- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/countries-and-regions): Trade agreements and relations with countries and regions
- [Countries and Regions - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/countries-and-regions/development): Country profiles, trade relations and bilateral agreements directory
- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/in-focus/eu-mexico-trade-agreement): EU-Mexico trade agreement and policy framework details
- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/in-focus/eu-singapore-agreement): EU-Singapore trade agreement and economic relations
- [Making trade policy - Trade and Economic Security - European Commission](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/policy/in-focus/eu-vietnam-agreement): EU-Vietnam trade agreement and bilateral trade relations

## Optional

- [EU Trade - The EU's Single Voice in International Trade](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/accessibility): Accessibility information for EU Trade website
- [EU Trade - The EU's Single Voice in International Trade](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/accessibility/index_en.htm): Accessibility statement and website information
- [EU Trade - The EU's Single Voice in International Trade](https://ec.europa.eu/trade/cookies/index_en.htm): Cookie policy and consent information
